raw_text: Pakistan-linked network ran 750 fake media outlets to target India at UN: EU DisinfoLab. A Brussels-based research group has exposed a Pakistan-linked influence operation that ran over 750 fake media outlets across 119 countries to push anti-India narratives at the United Nations Human Rights Council. EU DisinfoLab said the network, which it called 'Indian Chronicles,' used fake NGOs and impersonated defunct European newspapers to create an appearance of widespread criticism of India's human rights record. India's Ministry of External Affairs called the findings vindication of its long-standing claims about Pakistan's use of disinformation as state policy.
